challenge.title: Two-factor authentication
challenge.subtitle: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

intro.body: Two-factor authentication protects your trading account by requiring a code from your phone every time you sign in.
intro.bullet1: Use any TOTP-compatible app: Google Authenticator, Authy, 1Password, Bitwarden.
intro.bullet2: Trades, broker connections, and risk settings are gated behind 2FA.
intro.bullet3: You'll receive 10 single-use backup codes — store them safely.

qr.body: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app, OR copy the secret manually.
qr.alt: QR code containing the TOTP enrollment URI

verify.body: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app to confirm.

backup.body: Save these backup codes somewhere safe. Each one works exactly once and can sign you in if you lose your phone.
backup.warning: These will not be shown again. Store them now.
backup.confirm_saved: I've saved my backup codes in a safe place.

done.body: Two-factor authentication is now enabled on your account.

error.MFA_CODE_INVALID: That code didn't match. Try again.
error.TOKEN_INVALID: Your sign-in session expired. Please sign in again.
error.MFA_NOT_ENABLED: MFA is not enabled on this account.

list.title: Strategies
list.empty: No strategies yet. Upload one to get started.

upload.title: Upload a strategy
upload.subtitle: Upload your three-file bundle: Pine script, description, and webhook payload.

pine.label: Pine script (.pine)
pine.hint: Must start with //@version= within the first 64 bytes. Max 64 KB.

webhook.label: Webhook payload template (.json)
webhook.hint: Filename must be {{stem}}_Webhook.json. Required keys: strategy, action, symbol, qty, order_type.

warning.title: User-uploaded strategies are not tested by StratTraderPro
warning.body: Pine and webhook bytes are stored verbatim and never executed server-side. The shared secret is encrypted at rest. You are responsible for reviewing the strategy before enabling live execution.

acknowledge.label: I understand uploaded strategies are not tested by StratTraderPro. I accept the risk.

secret.label: HMAC secret
secret.reveal_once: Copy this secret now — it will not be shown again. Rotate it any time.
secret.hidden: Secret is hidden. Click Rotate to generate and reveal a new one.
